name: @aop/dashboard
description: AOP merchant dashboard — the Loss Diagnosis screen (agent impressions, reconciled orders, estimated losses, drop-off analysis, live WON/LOST stream) and the Data Optimizer panel (Agent Match Score + Semantic Policy Rewriter). React SPA served statically; reads the ingestion service's bearer-gated /analytics API and the optimizer microservice's /score + /rewrite endpoints.
